title: (RHBA-2021:1062) glusterfs bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated glusterfs packages that fix one bug are now available for Red Hat Gluster Storage 3.5 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Gluster Storage|Red Hat Gluster Storage Server for On-premise|3|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Gluster Storage is software only scale-out storage solution that provides flexible and affordable unstructured data storage. It unifies data storage and infrastructure, increases performance, and improves availability and manageability to meet enterprise-level storage challenges.

This advisory fixes the following bug:

* Due to the availability of a higher version of glusterfs client package in the RPM repository for the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Server, the updates at Red Hat Gluster Storage on the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 server are currently broken with package version conflict issues. With this release, the updates are no longer broken as the version of glusterfs server and glusterfs client packages available in the RPM repository for Red Hat Gluster Storage on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 are higher than the version of glusterfs client package currently available at the RPM repository for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Server. (BZ#1940935)

Users of glusterfs with Red Hat Gluster Storage are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
